chapter: The China offer, wedding and Shanghai
title: Shanghai night life and after-hours clubs
summary: He describes clubs staying open until daylight with bands, hostesses and plenty of money, while American bands played in hotels.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: So I knew it was coming because when we'd go to these, you see nightclubs in China at that time, would stay open until 6, 7, 8 o'clock in the morning with the bands, you know, all the girls, the hostess. And whenever you go to a club you wouldn't come out until daylight hours.
Why was night life like there? What was the reason for that, I an what was..........
It would just, during that time I guess, I don't know I wasn't in Paris at that time, but, I guess it must have been the same way.
Was there a lot of money there, I mean .........
Yes, I suppose that's a popular ......
Yes, a lot of money. And a lot of clubs. And they all had, they didn't just stay open, they had dancing and bands and everything.
: But were there other American bands there?
No, not in this, not in the after hours, they were in the hotels.
